name: 16505 · Erie, PA
findings: ZIP 16505 (Erie) has 88 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16505 (Erie) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 16505 (Erie) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 17% of all organizations here have no identified type.
